items.summary: Add the built mobile wrapper artifacts to the exact static paths expected by the app so the Downloads screen can show real, working download links: `frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` (served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa`).

On the `/downloads` page, when an artifact is available, display a visible, copyable direct URL for each artifact in addition to the download button (e.g., `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa`).
